description: Links the user's hardware Passkey (TouchID, FaceID, or YubiKey) to `@rel-time/mcp-server` for Biometric Anchors. Opens `https://rel-time.com/mcp-passkey` in the system browser, waits for the user's biometric touch, and saves `{ public_key_hex, passkey_signature }` to `~/.reltime/passkey.json`.

passkey_signature.description: Optional: Directly provide the passkey_signature session token from https://rel-time.com/mcp-passkey.

public_key_hex.description: Optional: Directly provide the COSE public_key_hex from https://rel-time.com/mcp-passkey without opening a browser window.

name: reltime_link_passkey
